build_moco_resnet_model: build a MoCo ResNet model with a base encoder, momentum encoder, and projector MLPs
build_moco_vit_model: build a MoCo Vision Transformer model with 3-layer projectors and 2-layer predictor MLPs
run_moco_forward_pass: run the MoCo forward pass with two image views and a momentum coefficient to get contrastive loss
test_contrastive_loss: test the MoCo contrastive loss function that normalizes features and computes cross-entropy with gathered targets
review_concat_all_gather: review the concat_all_gather utility that performs distributed all_gather and concatenates tensors across GPUs
